mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_FI_CARD, TB_FI_CORP_TAX, TB_FI_TAX_PAY, TB_FI_ITEM, TB_FI_LOAN, TB_FI_XFER, TB_CO_PREV_ADJ, TB_FI_CARD_MON, TB_FI_CARD_PAY, TB_CL_CLOSE, TB_CO_MON_PL IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE WHERE close_ym=#{month} AND close_stat_cd='CLOSE')
SELECT close_ym FROM TB_CL_CLOSE WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE' ORDER BY close_ym

SELECT item_sn::text AS id,mod_dttm AS version,fin_cls_cd,sga_item_cd,item_nm,amt,vat_amt,io_dt, rpt_yn,auto_fill_yn,upld_id::text AS upload_id,rmrk FROM TB_FI_ITEM WHERE fin_ym=#{month} ORDER BY item_sn
SELECT loan_sn::text AS id,mod_dttm AS version,loan_dt,io_cd,amt,cntprt_nm,rmrk FROM TB_FI_LOAN WHERE to_char(loan_dt,'YYYYMM')=#{month} ORDER BY loan_sn
SELECT xfer_sn::text AS id,mod_dttm AS version,xfer_dt,xfer_cls_cd,item_nm,rcvr_nm,amt,rmrk FROM TB_FI_XFER WHERE to_char(xfer_dt,'YYYYMM')=#{month} ORDER BY xfer_sn
SELECT adj_id::text AS id,mod_dttm AS version,trgt_ym,adj_item_cd,adj_amt,adj_rsn FROM TB_CO_PREV_ADJ WHERE aply_ym=#{month} ORDER BY adj_id

SELECT c.card_id,c.mod_dttm AS version,c.card_nm,c.card_no_l4,c.use_yn, COALESCE(p.pay_amt,0) AS pay_amt,p.mod_dttm AS monthly_version FROM TB_FI_CARD c LEFT JOIN TB_FI_CARD_PAY p ON p.card_id=c.card_id AND p.pay_ym=#{month} WHERE c.use_yn='Y' OR p.pay_amt>0 ORDER BY c.use_yn DESC,c.card_id
SELECT tax_yr::integer AS year,est_tax_amt,0::numeric AS monthly,false AS negative,mod_dttm AS version FROM TB_FI_CORP_TAX WHERE tax_yr=#{year}
mapper.sql: p.tax_yr||':'||p.pay_type_cd AS id,p.tax_yr::integer AS year,p.pay_type_cd,p.pay_due_dt,p.pay_amt, COALESCE(p.pay_amt,CASE WHEN p.pay_type_cd='MID' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(t.est_tax_amt,0)- COALESCE((SELECT mid.pay_amt FROM TB_FI_TAX_PAY mid WHERE mid.tax_yr=p.tax_yr AND mid.pay_type_cd='MID'),0) END) AS display_amount, p.pay_yn,p.pay_dt,CASE WHEN p.pay_yn='Y' THEN '납부' WHEN p.pay_due_dt < (clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date THEN '확인 필요' ELSE '예정' END AS status, p.mod_dttm AS version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_FI_TAX_PAY p LEFT JOIN TB_FI_CORP_TAX t ON t.tax_yr=p.tax_yr WHERE p.tax_yr=#{year} OR (p.tax_yr=(CAST(#{year} AS integer)-1)::text AND p.pay_type_cd='CNFM') OR (p.tax_yr < #{year} AND p.pay_yn='N') ORDER BY p.pay_due_dt,p.tax_yr,p.pay_type_cd
SELECT FROM TB_FI_TAX_PAY p LEFT JOIN TB_FI_CORP_TAX t ON t.tax_yr=p.tax_yr WHERE p.tax_yr=#{year} AND p.pay_type_cd=#{type}
SELECT cash_amt,(edit_yn='Y') AS manual,mod_dttm AS version FROM TB_FI_CARD_MON WHERE pay_ym=#{month}
SELECT COALESCE(corp_tax_amt,0) FROM TB_CO_MON_PL WHERE pl_ym=#{month}
SELECT code FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE code_grp_id=#{group} AND (code=#{value} OR code_nm=#{value}) AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N' ORDER BY CASE WHEN code=#{value} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
SELECT code_nm FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE code_grp_id=#{group} AND code=#{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FI_CORP_TAX(tax_yr,est_tax_amt,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES(#{year},COALESCE((SELECT est_tax_amt FROM TB_FI_CORP_TAX WHERE tax_yr=(CAST(#{year} AS integer)-1)::text),0),#{actor},clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(tax_yr) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO TB_FI_TAX_PAY(tax_yr,pay_type_cd,pay_due_dt,pay_amt,pay_yn,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES(#{year},'MID',make_date(CAST(#{year} AS integer),8,31),NULL,'N',#{actor},clock_timestamp()), (#{year},'CNFM',make_date(CAST(#{year} AS integer)+1,3,31),NULL,'N',#{actor},clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(tax_yr,pay_type_cd) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_FI_TAX_PAY SET pay_amt=#{input.actualPaymentAmount},pay_dt=#{input.actualPaymentDate},pay_yn='Y', mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE tax_yr=#{key.year} AND pay_type_cd=#{key.type} AND pay_yn='N' AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{input.modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}

UPDATE TB_FI_CORP_TAX SET est_tax_amt=#{row.estimatedTaxAmount},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE tax_yr=substring(#{month},1,4) AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{row.modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}

UPDATE TB_FI_TAX_PAY SET pay_due_dt=#{row.scheduledDate},pay_amt=#{row.paymentAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE tax_yr=split_part(#{row.paymentId},':',1) AND pay_type_cd=split_part(#{row.paymentId},':',2) AND pay_yn='N' AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{row.modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(max(item_sn),0)+1 FROM TB_FI_ITEM WHERE fin_ym=#{month}
SELECT nextval('SQ_TB_FI_LOAN')
SELECT nextval('SQ_TB_FI_XFER')
SELECT nextval('SQ_TB_CO_PREV_ADJ')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FI_ITEM(fin_ym,item_sn,fin_cls_cd,sga_item_cd,item_nm,amt,vat_amt,io_dt,rpt_yn,auto_fill_yn,rmrk,upld_id,reg_user_id,reg_dttm,mod_dttm) VALUES(#{month},CAST(#{row.itemId} AS numeric),#{row.classification},#{row.itemCode},#{row.itemName},#{row.amount}, COALESCE(#{row.vatAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC},0),#{row.cashDate},#{row.repeatYn},#{row.autoFillYn},#{row.memo}, CAST(#{row.uploadId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS numeric),#{actor},clock_timestamp(),clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_FI_ITEM SET fin_cls_cd=#{row.classification},sga_item_cd=#{row.itemCode},item_nm=#{row.itemName},amt=#{row.amount}, vat_amt=COALESCE(#{row.vatAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC},0),io_dt=#{row.cashDate},rpt_yn=#{row.repeatYn},rmrk=#{row.memo},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE fin_ym=#{month} AND item_sn=CAST(#{row.itemId} AS numeric) AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{row.modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}

UPDATE TB_FI_CARD SET card_nm=#{row.cardName},card_no_l4=#{row.lastFourDigits},use_yn=#{row.useYn},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE card_id=#{row.cardId} AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{row.modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FI_CARD_PAY(pay_ym,card_id,pay_amt,reg_user_id,reg_dttm,mod_dttm) VALUES(#{month},#{row.cardId},#{row.amount},#{actor},clock_timestamp(),clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(pay_ym,card_id) DO UPDATE SET pay_amt=EXCLUDED.pay_amt,mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE TB_FI_CARD_PAY.mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{row.monthlyModifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}

INSERT INTO TB_FI_CARD_MON(pay_ym,card_sum_amt,cash_amt,edit_yn,reg_user_id,reg_dttm,mod_dttm) VALUES(#{write.month},#{total},#{write.row.paymentAmount},CASE WHEN #{write.row.manualOverride} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{write.actor},clock_timestamp(),clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT(pay_ym) DO UPDATE SET card_sum_amt=EXCLUDED.card_sum_amt,cash_amt=EXCLUDED.cash_amt,edit_yn=EXCLUDED.edit_yn,mod_user_id=#{write.actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE TB_FI_CARD_MON.mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{write.row.modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_FI_ITEM WHERE fin_ym=#{month} AND item_sn=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
DELETE FROM TB_FI_LOAN WHERE to_char(loan_dt,'YYYYMM')=#{month} AND loan_sn=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
DELETE FROM TB_FI_XFER WHERE to_char(xfer_dt,'YYYYMM')=#{month} AND xfer_sn=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
DELETE FROM TB_CO_PREV_ADJ WHERE aply_ym=#{month} AND adj_id=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
DELETE FROM TB_FI_ITEM WHERE fin_ym=#{month} AND upld_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CO_MON_PL SET sga_input_amt=#{row.sga},sga_tot_amt=#{row.sga}+COALESCE(indrct_labor_amt,0)+COALESCE(rnd_amt,0), prev_adj_amt=#{row.adjustment},nopr_incm_amt=#{row.income},nopr_exps_amt=#{row.expense},corp_tax_amt=#{row.tax}, oprt_prft_amt=sales_amt-sales_cost_amt-#{row.sga}-COALESCE(indrct_labor_amt,0)-COALESCE(rnd_amt,0)+#{row.adjustment}, net_prft_amt=sales_amt-sales_cost_amt-#{row.sga}-COALESCE(indrct_labor_amt,0)-COALESCE(rnd_amt,0)+#{row.adjustment}+#{row.income}-#{row.expense}-#{row.tax}, mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE pl_ym=#{row.month} AND fix_yn='N' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.close_ym=#{row.month} AND c.close_stat_cd='CLOSE')
mapper.select: SELECT s.month,s.category,sum(s.amount) AS amount FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(to_char(i.io_dt,'YYYYMM'),i.fin_ym) AS month,'EXPENSE' AS category,i.amt+i.vat_amt AS amount FROM TB_FI_ITEM i WHERE i.fin_cls_cd IN ('SGA','NOPR_OUT') UNION ALL SELECT to_char(i.io_dt,'YYYYMM'),'OTHER_INCOME',i.amt FROM TB_FI_ITEM i WHERE i.fin_cls_cd='NOPR_IN' AND i.io_dt IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT to_char(l.loan_dt,'YYYYMM'),'LOAN',CASE WHEN l.io_cd='IN' THEN l.amt ELSE -l.amt END FROM TB_FI_LOAN l UNION ALL SELECT to_char(x.xfer_dt,'YYYYMM'),CASE WHEN x.xfer_cls_cd='SPCL' THEN 'UNPAID_LABOR' ELSE 'EXPENSE' END,x.amt FROM TB_FI_XFER x UNION ALL SELECT c.pay_ym,'EXPENSE',c.cash_amt FROM TB_FI_CARD_MON c UNION ALL SELECT to_char(CASE WHEN p.pay_yn='Y' THEN p.pay_dt ELSE p.pay_due_dt END,'YYYYMM'),'CORPORATE_TAX', COALESCE(p.pay_amt,CASE WHEN p.pay_type_cd='MID' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(t.est_tax_amt,0)-COALESCE(m.pay_amt,0) END) FROM TB_FI_TAX_PAY p LEFT JOIN TB_FI_CORP_TAX t ON t.tax_yr=p.tax_yr LEFT JOIN TB_FI_TAX_PAY m ON m.tax_yr=p.tax_yr AND m.pay_type_cd='MID' ) s GROUP BY s.month,s.category ORDER BY s.month,s.category
